dct_description_sm: To compare food web structure in a resource-limited sub-Arctic lake before and after the introduction of an anadromous Arctic charr population to determine whether there have been significant alterations in food web structure. Specifically, we test the hypotheses that introduction of Arctic charr would: (1) shift the isotopic ratios of resident fish species with pelagic and littoral dietary preferences; (2) increase omnivory in lake trout diets as a result of Arctic charr becoming a prey resource; and, (3) alter food web metrics by increasing the overall vertical food web length (NR) and forage fish redundancy (NND) within the fish community, while having no effect on niche diversification at the base of the food web (CR) or other qualitative characteristics of the resident fish community trophic structure.
dct_title_s: Measuring the ecological impacts of introducing Arctic charr to sub-Arctic lakes
